intro: One set of ayam tandoori with naan has about 650 kcal (estimate). The naan gives the most calories. The ayam tandoori is your main protein source.

variants.name: Ayam tandoori with salad, no naan

diet: Yes, this is one of the best choices at a mamak. Ayam tandoori is grilled, not fried, and high in protein. Calories go up if you pick cheese or butter naan. Stick to plain naan and you get a balanced meal.
tips: Go for plain naan, not cheese or butter naan.
Remove the chicken skin if you want less fat.
Ask for extra onion salad and use mint chutney as your sauce.

swap.name: Ayam tandoori with chapati
swap.why: Chapati is thinner and less oily than naan, but you still get the same chicken protein.

faq.a: The red colour comes from Kashmiri chilli powder, spices and sometimes food colouring. The chicken is marinated in yogurt and spices before grilling.
Traditionally it's cooked in a clay oven called a tandoor. At home, you can use an oven or air fryer.
That's mint chutney, made from mint leaves, coriander, green chilli and sometimes yogurt. It's fresh and low in calories.
